code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild monocytosis and basophilia. MCHC is slightly low. There is also mild hyperchloremia and low ALT. These findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or an acute infectious/inflammatory process. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended to determine the underlying cause and assess for possible hypoxic or hematologic disorders.
